parent_objective: audit completed taxonomy outcomes under revised semantics before ranking or paper claims
blocked_by: M1765 validates completion but outcome interpretation is not audited
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from completed artifact

public_gates: M1766 must use only existing M1764 aggregate artifacts
M1766 must separate benchmark diagnostic_stress and mitigation_diagnostic outcomes
M1766 must identify whether outcome dominance blocks ranking
M1766 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs or claim paper-level evidence
M1766 must decide whether to route to controller-family comparison design outcome repair branch synthesis or stop

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: interprets completed public diagnostic outcomes under revised semantics without ranking
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: outcome audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if outcome dominance makes ranking invalid
stop if aggregate artifacts are insufficient
stop if audit would directly claim paper-level benchmark evidence
fallback_plan: route to outcome repair/localization if dominance blocks ranking
route to controller-family comparison design if outcomes are interpretable
route to branch synthesis if public overfit risk or outcome dominance remains high
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1765 validates the completed public diagnostic artifact

admission_evidence: M1765 validates M1764 completion as 864 rows zero failures with explicit seed-repair provenance
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1766 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; outcome audit does not prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve profile controls for later self-ID specific gates
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1764 completed public diagnostic artifact only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Classify poor outcomes as task-quality evidence rather than self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The completed M1764 taxonomy outcomes can be audited to decide whether ranking is admissible or outcome dominance still blocks interpretation.
success_criteria: audit uses M1764 aggregate artifacts only
audit separates evaluation roles and primary metric families
audit explicitly permits or blocks controller-family ranking route
rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes profile tuning ranking paper-level and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit runs new rollout or changes configs
audit claims paper-level or level3 evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1764 aggregate artifacts without rollout

decision_rule: M1766 passes if it audits completed outcomes and routes ranking/repair without making ranking or paper claims.
